title.zh: 无缝曲面细分：precise 与 fma

subtitle.zh: 为什么一个普通的 Bezier 求值函数会破坏面片间的无缝性，以及 `precise` 和 `fma` 是怎么把它救回来的。
subtitle.en: Why an ordinary Bezier evaluation breaks watertightness between patches, and how precise and fma fix it.

translator.note: 按任务约定，`precise` 限定符与 `fma` 一律保留英文，不译成「精确限定符」「融合乘加」；正文里首次出现 fma 时保留原文的加粗拆字写法（原文为 `**f**used **m**ultiply-**a**dd`，中文里改为保留英文全称 `fused multiply-add` 并紧随其缩写，不强行在中文词上做首字母加粗）。公式、变量名（`x`、`p0`、`B0`、`bar`、`tc`）与代码块按「代码原样」规则逐字保留英文，注释也不译。源文里的引用块（Direct3D 文档、OpenGL 规范各一段）按 schema 放进 `quote` 块。`Direct3D 11`、`OpenGL 4`、`Cg`、`NVIDIA`、`IEEE 754-2008`、`Bezier` 保留英文；watertight 作「无缝」，tessellation 作「曲面细分」，patch 作「面片」。

blocks.en: One important feature of Direct3D 11 and OpenGL 4, which I have seen very little written about, is the addition of a new `precise` qualifier. It’s no surprise there’s some confusion about the purpose and motivation for this new keyword. The [Direct3D documentation](http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb509706(VS.85).aspx) is vague about it:
blocks.zh: Direct3D 11 和 OpenGL 4 有一个重要的新特性，我几乎没见人写过：新增的 `precise` 限定符。关于这个新关键字的目的和动机存在一些困惑，这并不奇怪。[Direct3D 的文档](http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb509706(VS.85).aspx)对它的描述就很含糊：

blocks.en: precise affects all results that contribute to the variable’s outcome by preventing the compiler from doing unsafe optimizations. For instance, to improve performance the compiler ingores the possibility of NaN and INF results for floating point variables from constant and stream inputs in order to do several optimizations. By using the precise keyword, these optimizations will be prohibited for all calculations affecting the result of the variable.
blocks.zh: precise 通过阻止编译器进行不安全的优化，影响所有对变量取值有贡献的结果。例如，为了提升性能，编译器会忽略常量与流输入中浮点变量出现 NaN 和 INF 结果的可能性，以便进行若干优化。使用 precise 关键字后，对所有影响该变量结果的计算，这些优化都会被禁止。

blocks.en: Besides the typos (ingores?), it’s not very clear what “unsafe optimizations” actually means, since only a single example is provided. On the other side, the [OpenGL specification](http://www.opengl.org/registry/specs/ARB/gpu_shader5.txt) is a lot more “precise”:
blocks.zh: 除了那个拼写错误（ingores？）之外，「不安全的优化」到底指什么也不太清楚，因为只给了一个例子。反过来说，[OpenGL 的规范](http://www.opengl.org/registry/specs/ARB/gpu_shader5.txt)就「precise」得多：

blocks.en: The qualifier “precise” will ensure that operations contributing to a variable’s value are performed in the order and with the precision specified in the source code. Order of evaluation is determined by operator precedence and parentheses, as described in Section 5. Expressions must be evaluated with a precision consistent with the operation; for example, multiplying two “float” values must produce a single value with “float” precision. This effectively prohibits the arbitrary use of fused multiply-add operations if the intermediate multiply result is kept at a higher precision.
blocks.zh: 「precise」限定符会确保：对某个变量取值有贡献的运算，都按源码所指定的顺序与精度执行。求值顺序由运算符优先级与括号决定，如第 5 节所述。表达式必须按与该运算一致的精度求值；例如，两个「float」值相乘必须产生一个「float」精度的单一值。如果乘法的中间结果被保持在更高的精度上，这实际上就禁止了随意使用融合乘加运算。

blocks.en: OpenGL makes it clear that precise causes operations to be performed in the exact order prescribed by the language rules. It also highlights that the precision of the operations must also be exactly as prescribed and not greater, which rules out the use of fused multiply-add if implemented according to the [IEEE 754-2008](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_754-2008) specification, to which most modern GPUs conform.
blocks.zh: OpenGL 说得很清楚：precise 会让运算严格按语言规则规定的顺序执行。它还指出，运算的精度也必须严格按规定的来，不能更高——如果融合乘加是按 [IEEE 754-2008](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_754-2008) 规范实现的（大多数现代 GPU 都遵循它），这就把融合乘加排除掉了。

blocks.en: Today we take watertight rasterization for granted. This is something that most of us don’t even have to think about, since the fixed function hardware takes care of it automatically.
blocks.zh: 今天我们觉得无缝光栅化是理所当然的。这件事大多数人根本不用去想，因为固定功能硬件会自动处理好。

blocks.en: On the other side, when using tessellation, triangle vertices are generated by programable shaders that run independently for adjacent patches, which usually have arbitrary parametric orientations. Obtaining watertightness of tessellated patches requires a lot of care to guarantee that vertices shared between adjacent patches are evaluated consistently. As opposed to rasterization, in this case the responsibility to obtain watertightness lies in the hands of the programmer.
blocks.zh: 反过来说，用曲面细分时，三角形顶点是可编程着色器生成的，而相邻面片各自独立运行，它们的参数方向通常又是任意的。要让细分出来的面片无缝，得非常小心，保证相邻面片之间共享的顶点被一致地求值。与光栅化不同，这里的无缝与否责任在程序员手上。

blocks.en: In my first experiments it became clear that this was not only hard to achieve, it was simply impossible. Fortunately, at NVIDIA I had access to the whole software stack, so by using a custom Cg compiler, running with developer drivers, and turning some knobs, I could prevent unwanted optimizations from happening and confirm that it was indeed possible to obtain watertight results. On the other hand, this solution was not very efficient, what we needed was to have fine grained control over the way the compiler turned our expressions into code; preventing optimizations only in the situations where it mattered.
blocks.zh: 在我最初的实验里就很清楚：这件事不只是难，而是根本做不到。幸好我在 NVIDIA 能接触到整个软件栈，所以我用一个自制的 Cg 编译器、配合开发者驱动、再拧几个开关，就能阻止那些不想要的优化发生，并确认无缝的结果确实是可以做到的。另一方面，这个方案效率不高。我们真正需要的，是细粒度地控制编译器把我们写的表达式变成代码的方式：只在真正要紧的地方阻止优化。

blocks.en: Among all the solutions proposed, the addition of a precise qualifier and an fma (**f**used **m**ultiply-**a**dd) intrinsic is the solution that caught on.
blocks.zh: 在所有被提出的方案中，最终流行起来的是加入 precise 限定符和一个 fma（fused multiply-add，融合乘加）内建函数。

blocks.en: To understand how the solution works, let’s look at some simple code that evaluates a cubic curve:
blocks.zh: 要理解这个方案是怎么起作用的，先看一段求三次曲线的简单代码：

blocks.en: In most situations that would work fine. However, when doing tessellation you need to be more careful. If you have two cubic surfaces adjacent to each other, but their parametric orientations do not agree, and we use that function to evaluate the surface on the boundary, then the resulting positions will also not agree.
blocks.zh: 大多数情况下这样没问题。但做曲面细分时，你得更加小心。如果你有两块彼此相邻的三次曲面，但它们的参数方向不一致，而我们又用那个函数去求边界上的曲面，那么得到的位置也不会一致。

blocks.en: That is because the following condition is not true:
blocks.zh: 原因在于下面这个等式并不成立：

blocks.code: cubic(x, a, b, c, d) == cubic(1-x, d, c, b, a);

blocks.en: That is, the evaluation of the curve is not symmetric. The result of evaluating the curve at `x` is not the same if you change the order of the control points and evaluate it at `1-x`.
blocks.zh: 也就是说，曲线的求值不是对称的。把控制点的顺序反过来、再在 `1-x` 处求值，得到的结果和在 `x` 处求值并不相同。

blocks.en: It might seem counter-intuitive, but the way the compiler translates those expressions into a sequence of instructions does not guarantee symmetry. The computation itself must be expressed independent of parametric orientation.
blocks.zh: 这看起来可能反直觉，但编译器把这些表达式翻译成指令序列的方式并不保证对称性。计算本身必须写成与参数方向无关的形式。

blocks.en: Simply adding the precise qualifier to the result does not really solve our problems:
blocks.zh: 单纯给结果加上 precise 限定符并不能真正解决问题：

blocks.en: Note the order in which the operations are performed:
blocks.zh: 注意运算的执行顺序：

blocks.en: Writing the expression with parenthesis to emphasize the evaluation order makes it clear that the expression does not have a symmetric structure, so it still doesn’t meet our requisite. What we should do then is to rewrite the expression as follows:
blocks.zh: 用括号把这个表达式的求值顺序标出来就很清楚：它并不具备对称结构，所以还是不满足我们的要求。那么我们应该把表达式改写成这样：

blocks.en: It looks like now it should not matter in what direction the curve is evaluated, the result should be the same… but that’s not yet the case. If you look at the basis functions you will notice another problem:
blocks.zh: 看起来现在无论从哪个方向求值，结果都应该一样了……但还不行。如果你看看基函数，会注意到另一个问题：

blocks.en: `B1` and `B2` are not symmetric either. In order to guarantee that `B1(x) == B2(1-x)`, they should be written as follows:
blocks.zh: `B1` 和 `B2` 也不对称。要保证 `B1(x) == B2(1-x)`，它们应该写成这样：

blocks.en: That is getting closer to being correct, but there are still some problems. The precise qualifier only affects the expressions on the right hand side of the precise variable. That is, the above code is equivalent to:
blocks.zh: 这已经接近正确了，但还是有些问题。precise 限定符只影响那个 precise 变量右侧的表达式。也就是说，上面的代码等价于：

blocks.en: So, the compiler is free to mess with our carefully arranged expressions. Instead we should declare all of them as precise:
blocks.zh: 所以编译器可以随意摆弄我们精心安排的表达式。我们应当把它们全都声明为 precise：

blocks.en: OK, this code is finally watertight! The only problem now is that the resulting code is much more expensive than our original implementation.
blocks.zh: 好，这段代码终于无缝了！现在唯一的问题是，生成的代码比我们最初的实现贵得多。

blocks.en: In both cases the evaluation of the Bezier basis requires about 7 scalar instructions. However, the evaluation of the curve used 12 instructions, while now it requires 21 instructions and one extra register. This is where we can use the fma intrinsic. We can use fma and still obtain symmetric results, but we have to tell the compiler explicitly when is it possible to do so. In this case, the resulting expression is as follows:
blocks.zh: 两种情况下，Bezier 基函数的求值都大约需要 7 条标量指令。不过曲线的求值原先用 12 条指令，现在需要 21 条指令外加一个额外寄存器。这时就可以用上 fma 内建函数了。我们能用 fma 而仍然得到对称的结果，但必须明确告诉编译器什么时候可以这么做。在这个例子里，得到的表达式如下：

blocks.code: fma(p1, vec3(B1), (p0 * B0)) + fma(p2, vec3(B2), (p3 * B3))

blocks.en: This preserves the symmetry of the computation and only requires 15 instructions, much better!
blocks.zh: 这样既保住了计算的对称性，又只需要 15 条指令，好多了！

blocks.en: In order to think more easily about the cost of the different implementations I use the following notation:
blocks.zh: 为了更容易地衡量不同实现的成本，我用下面这套记号：

blocks.en: Here the stars (`*`) represent mul instructions, the crosses (`+`) represent add instructions, and the arrows (`><`) represent fma instructions. The dashes (`-`) simply describe the dependencies between instructions and the order of evaluation in a loose way.
blocks.zh: 这里星号（`*`）代表 mul 指令，加号（`+`）代表 add 指令，箭头（`><`）代表 fma 指令。短横线（`-`）只是大致描述指令之间的依赖关系和求值顺序。

blocks.en: Take note, because in the next article I’ll be using this notation more extensively.
blocks.zh: 记一下，因为下一篇文章里我会更频繁地用这套记号。
